# Tuning job adapters

`run.sh` executes selected tuning and post-tuning numerical drivers. `compare.py` compares explicit baseline and candidate CSV files; `check_regression.sh` applies the retained job's thresholds.

Use the same workload, hardware and measurement settings for both inputs. A timing comparison does not replace the numerical checks. The [script index](../../README.md) links the callers, and the [tuning guide](../../../../aiter/tuning/README.md) describes the owning library workflow.
